spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact new members (createWritable on the duplex prototype, the WebTransportDatagramsWritable interface and its direct WritableStream inheritance) and, where present, calls createWritable() on a connecting transport checking the spec's defaults (sendGroup null, sendOrder 0).

interactive.rationale: One button runs the full probe including a real construction and real method call; the era table dates the build from both the new and legacy surfaces.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises prototype checks, a real call with default inspection, and the legacy-surface read; all three render.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles no-WebTransport, construction-throw, method-absent (honest pre-155 verdict), and method-present-but-call-throws branches; the legacy datagrams.writable is surfaced as the compatibility artefact it is.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus 5183354944225280 and the spec's datagram-writable section.

conformance.rationale: New 10-assertion suite covers the interface shape, real defaults, option round-trip + mutation, independent writables, and the two async write rules; executes 2 pass / 7 fail / 1 blocked on Chromium 141, with the non-BufferSource rule genuinely PASSING via the legacy writable.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via the repo CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): probe driven at 1280×900 and 360×740, overflowX 0, zero failed requests, clean console apart from the intentional dead-endpoint lines; honest pre-155 verdict with the legacy surface correctly dated. Partial: the created-writable inspection rows need a 155+/flagged build.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts that when the method exists the call must return a WritableStream with spec defaults; fallback branch asserted explicitly; promises claimed.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; result columns pair emerald/rose with text; buttons override background and color together.

accessibility.rationale: Captioned tables with th scope, native button, one polite verdict region, no color-only cells.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Driven at both classes with 0px horizontal overflow; long member names word-break; both screenshots read.

openQuestions.detail: On a Chrome 155+ build (or --enable-blink-features=WebTransportSendGroup,WebTransportDatagramsWritable), confirm the call rows go green: createWritable() returns a WebTransportDatagramsWritable instanceof WritableStream with sendGroup null / sendOrder 0, and the era table reads both surfaces present.
